selection.method: development-only evolutionary tuning followed by range and preflop-table ablations
selection.model_provenance: PyPokerEngine HonestPlayer Monte Carlo equity model adapted to short-deck PLO5; no externally pretrained weights

adaptation.method: contextual Bayesian counts, decayed global fallback, conservative fold uncertainty and small pot-control margin; development comparisons with frozen50b4682

neural_revision.method: calm split-margin policy with covariance-weighted neural equity anchor; all-in/future-loss-bound corrections; failed draw-range/CFR/refinement variants disabled
neural_revision.neural_training: 80000 random flop/turn positions,384 legal rollouts each; independent1500x4096 validation and8fixedboardsx64x2048 validation
neural_revision.selection_caveat: Development shows robust incumbent gains but not a statistically established balanced-field EV improvement. NN incremental match contribution is uncertain.
